findings_qualitative.value: Six conformers assigned; aG'Ag is the global minimum; no detection of 12BD in ALMA Band 3 data; best searches expected at 400–800 GHz (bands 8–9).

evidence.quote: Search for the corresponding 30 x,30 −29 x,29 transition lines toward IRAS 16293-2422 B was unsuccessful.

claims.hypothesis: 12BD can be detected toward IRAS 16293-2422 B in archival Band 3 data
claims.experiment: Searched the predicted aG'Ag 30-29 quartet in the extracted ALMA spectrum
claims.finding: Non-detection is attributed to the emission peaking at higher frequencies; bands 8–9 are better

evidence.quote: No detection was found, but this could be justified by the fact that the maximum spectral signal of this kind of heavy compounds is predicted at higher frequencies (bands 8–9).

why_this_data.value: Project 2012.1.00712.S has frequency coverage and spectral resolution similar to the laboratory measurements

limitations_admitted.value: The ALMA project was not aimed at searching this molecule; higher-frequency predictions need more lab data.

evidence.quote: The ALMA project, from which the data were extracted, was in fact, not specifically aimed at searching this molecule.
